author: massicomar
title: Distinct Values Queries
summary:
You are given an array of $n$ integers and $q$ queries of the form: how many distinct values are there in a range $[a,b]$?

Input

The first input line has two integers $n$ and $q$: the array size and number of queries.

The next line has $n$ integers $x_1,x_2,\dots,x_n$: the array values.

Finally, there are $q$ lines describing the queries. Each line has two integers $a$ and $b$.

Output

For each query, print the number of distinct values in the range.
explanation: Sort queries by right end; keep a 1 only at each value's last occurrence in a BIT; answer = range sum.
traps: Distinct counts don't merge from two halves.

es.explanation: Ordena las consultas por extremo derecho; en un BIT, deja un 1 solo en la última aparición de cada valor; respuesta = suma en el rango.
traps: Las cantidades de distintos no se combinan desde dos mitades.
